proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3674 kṣāra explicitly gives Gujarati khār/khārī salt and Konkani khāru salt, beside khāro saline/brackish forms. The western kharo/khāro/khāru/khara/kharõ survey nouns fit this salt/alkali family, with endings and nasalization retained; local Indo-Aryan contact remains open. Exact response: kharo.
